description:
Kalyana Lakshmi Pathakam is a welfare scheme launched by the Government of Telangana on October 2, 2014. 

The scheme was initiated to provide financial assistance to the families of brides belonging to economically weaker sections. 

The primary objective of Kalyana Lakshmi Pathakam is to support the marriage of girls from low-income families. 

The scheme aims to reduce the financial burden on families when it comes to marriage expenses. 

The government has set a measurable target of providing financial assistance to at least 1 lakh families annually. 

Under this scheme, the financial assistance provided is ₹1,00,116 for the marriage of a girl child. 

This amount is directly credited to the bank account of the bride's family. 

The assistance is provided irrespective of the caste or religion of the beneficiaries. 

To be eligible for the Kalyana Lakshmi Pathakam, the bride must be a resident of Telangana. 

The bride must also be at least 18 years old at the time of marriage. 

The family income of the bride's household should not exceed ₹2 lakh per annum. 

This income limit is assessed based on the income certificate issued by the relevant authorities. 

The scheme is applicable for marriages that take place after the registration of the bride under the scheme. 

To apply for Kalyana Lakshmi Pathakam, the applicant must follow a specific process. 

The first step is to register the marriage in the local revenue office. 

The applicant must provide a marriage registration certificate as part of the documentation. 

Additionally, the applicant must submit an application form available at the local Mandal Revenue Office. 

The application form requires details such as the bride's name, age, and family income. 

The applicant must also provide proof of residence in Telangana. 

Documents required include an Aadhaar card and a bank account statement. 

Once the application is submitted, it is verified by the Mandal Revenue Officer. 

The verification process typically takes about 15 days. 

After successful verification, the financial assistance is disbursed. 

The amount is credited to the bank account of the bride's family within 30 days of approval. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Women Development and Child Welfare, Telangana. 

The contact details for the department can be found on the official Telangana government website. 

The Kalyana Lakshmi Pathakam has seen significant uptake since its inception. 

As of 2023, over 3 lakh brides have benefited from this scheme. 

The total amount disbursed under the scheme has exceeded ₹3,000 crores. 

The government has made provisions to ensure that the funds are allocated efficiently. 

Regular audits are conducted to ensure transparency in the disbursement process. 

The scheme has contributed to reducing child marriages in the state. 

It has also empowered families by alleviating the financial pressures associated with weddings. 

The Kalyana Lakshmi Pathakam is part of a broader initiative by the Telangana government to promote social welfare. 

The scheme aligns with the government's commitment to gender equality and women's empowerment. 

The initiative has also received positive feedback from various women's organizations. 

The government has plans to expand the scheme to include more beneficiaries in the coming years. 

The Kalyana Lakshmi Pathakam is a testament to the Telangana government's focus on social welfare. 

It aims to create a supportive environment for families in need. 

The scheme has been instrumental in changing societal perceptions regarding marriage expenses. 

Overall, Kalyana Lakshmi Pathakam is a significant step towards ensuring that financial constraints do not hinder the marriage of girls from economically weaker sections. 

The scheme has been well-received by the public and has set a precedent for similar initiatives in other states. 

The government continues to monitor the scheme's effectiveness and make necessary adjustments. 

The Kalyana Lakshmi Pathakam exemplifies the Telangana government's proactive approach to welfare. 

It is a clear indication of the government's commitment to improving the lives of its citizens. 

The scheme is an essential part of the state's efforts to promote social justice and equity. 

The Kalyana Lakshmi Pathakam is a model that could inspire similar programs across India. 

By providing financial assistance, the scheme empowers families and promotes social stability. 

The initiative has also been praised for its inclusivity and accessibility. 

The Kalyana Lakshmi Pathakam is a vital resource for families in Telangana. 

It serves as a beacon of hope for those facing financial difficulties related to marriage. 

The scheme's success can be attributed to its straightforward application process and transparent disbursement. 

The government encourages eligible families to take advantage of this beneficial program. 

The Kalyana Lakshmi Pathakam is a significant welfare initiative that addresses a critical social issue. 

It reflects the government's understanding of the cultural importance of marriage in Indian society. 

The scheme has made a tangible difference in the lives of many families across Telangana. 

As the program continues to evolve, it is expected to reach even more beneficiaries in the future. 

The Kalyana Lakshmi Pathakam stands as a model of effective governance and social welfare. 

It highlights the importance of targeted assistance in addressing specific community needs. 

The scheme is a vital part of Telangana's broader social welfare framework. 

It demonstrates the potential for government initiatives to create lasting positive change. 

The Kalyana Lakshmi Pathakam is a commendable effort by the Telangana government. 

It showcases the importance of supporting families during significant life events. 

The scheme is a crucial step towards ensuring that every girl has the opportunity for a dignified marriage. 

The Kalyana Lakshmi Pathakam is a testament to the power of government action in promoting social welfare.
